notes: Tracked renewal spikes and notable pricing structure changes across US-market hosting providers.

snapshots.observation: First 12 months at $1/mo ($12), followed by 24 months at $14/mo ($336) = $348 total over 36 months.
Lowest effective cost requires 1-year promo ($35.88) followed by $17.99/mo renewals ($431.76 for years 2-3).
Advertised $2.99/mo requires 48-month upfront prepayment ($143.52); 12-month term is higher and renews at $7.99/mo.
Price Lock Guarantee keeps renewal rate identical to initial rate ($2.50/mo).
Flat month-to-month cloud VPS pricing in Ashburn, VA and Hillsboro, OR with zero renewal increase.
